description: Aggregates data center capacity, substations, transmission lines, gas pipelines, dark fiber, water stress, flood hazards, and moratoria within a radius or bounding box. Pass a city, coordinates, bounding box, or project name.

bbox.description: Geographic bounding box [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] (e.g. [-100.0, 32.0, -99.0, 33.0]).

latitude.description: Center latitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. 39.9612).

location.description: City, county, or market name (e.g. 'Columbus, OH', 'Ashburn, VA').

longitude.description: Center longitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. -82.9988).

max_lat.description: Northern latitude boundary in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. 33.0).

max_lon.description: Eastern longitude boundary in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. -99.0).

min_lat.description: Southern latitude boundary in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. 32.0).

min_lon.description: Western longitude boundary in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. -100.0).

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

project_id.description: Optional project ID to summarize the area around (e.g. 'P017').

project_name.description: Optional project name to center the area summary on (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene').

query.description: City, county, or project name to center the area summary on (e.g. 'Columbus, OH').

radius_km.description: Alias for search radius in kilometers (e.g. 40).

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around center coordinates (default: 25).

site.description: Project name, site name, city, county, or canonical ID (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').

weights.description: Optional custom weights map for composite area scoring.

name: query_area_intelligence_summary

next_useful_tools.description: Suggested follow-up MCP tools relevant to this result.

status.description: Execution status (OK, SUCCESS, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY, NOT_FOUND, ERROR).

using_project.description: Banner confirming the resolved project name, city, state, and canonical ID when a project was matched.

title: Query Area Intelligence Summary
